summary: Outputs a TOP directly to Vulkan direct display surfaces, bypassing the Windows desktop compositor and Window COMP.

key_params.name: hwframelock
key_params.note: Enable hardware frame lock when licensed and configured

common_gotchas: This is not a normal window output path; display removal and Mosaic/QSync style setup happen outside TouchDesigner.
Workstation NVIDIA RTX/Quadro hardware and Windows 11 Pro for Workstations or Enterprise are part of the documented setup.
The official tool name is configureDdisplay.exe.
Hardware frame lock requires a Pro license.
key_concepts: Direct Display Out TOP sends image output to direct-display hardware surfaces rather than a normal Window COMP.
It can bypass the Windows Desktop and compositor for reliable playback display paths.
The workflow depends on external display removal and setup outside TouchDesigner.
The operator can control up to three outputs.
Hardware frame lock is a Pro-only feature.
The workflow is Windows/NVIDIA workstation oriented and requires matching OS and GPU setup.
